title: Blaschka source corpus ingest priority
principle: Prioritize sources that can be ingested now or retrieved by a precise archival unit. Repository discovery alone has lower value than document-level or corpus-level access.

priorities.target: BHL Rudolf Blaschka letters to Walter Deane, 1895–1927
priorities.action: Download OCR/text and page metadata; preserve display-label and structured-date fields separately; create one record per dated correspondence part/page.
priorities.reason: Large direct primary corpus available immediately with no archive visit.

priorities.target: Existing Rakow/Blaschka OCR workshop corpus already in project backend
priorities.action: Cross-walk Deane dates and names against business letters, Lieferungs-Buch, Geschäfts Anmerkungen, packing and shipping records.
priorities.reason: Provides the workshop/business side needed to interpret the new Deane corpus without collapsing private and commercial correspondence.

priorities.target: University of Rochester A.W23 and D.231 Ward archives
priorities.action: Request or inspect Blaschka-specific customer correspondence, invoices, catalogue/order records, packing/shipping and account rows.
priorities.reason: Only concentrated dealer-side personal + corporate archive in the three principal distribution routes.

priorities.target: UCD Archives IE UCDA RCSI accounts 1883–1885 and equipment/supplies order books 1867–1916
priorities.action: Search exact 13 June 1885 transaction and 495/619-Mark totals; identify any intermediary/commission notation.
priorities.reason: A precise receiving-side archive may close the unexplained 124-Mark commission layer.

priorities.target: Charles Francis Adams Diary, Illinois collection 782
priorities.action: Read January–May 1885 daily entries around Ward shipment arrival; code wharf, package, museum handoff, unpacking and payment references.
priorities.reason: Personal archive of a named carrier/preparator/payment intermediary in the Auckland Blaschka transaction.

priorities.target: MNCN/Simurg Robert F. Damon catalogues and dispatch note, 1885–1906
priorities.action: Transcribe catalogue headings, list structure, prices if present, customer/dispatch notation and language.
priorities.reason: Same-period Damon business paperwork can supply a control vocabulary for British/Irish Blaschka transactions.

priorities.target: Smithsonian SIA RU007095 Box 1 specimen lists, 1861–1865
priorities.action: Isolate Damon lists and financial entries and compare with Talling/Vaux inside the same customer archive.
priorities.reason: Controlled pre-agency comparator for dealer list, purchase and exchange practices.

priorities.target: Frič–Antipa letters nos. 168–172 and associated inventory/registers
priorities.action: Use as a coding template for dealer → receiving inventory → surviving object crosswalk.
priorities.reason: Excellent longitudinal comparator but postdates Blaschka marine-model production.

priorities.target: BayHStA ZSS 113/124/127 and related dealer acquisition files
priorities.action: Compare Frič, Damon, Ward and adjacent dealers under one museum administrative system.
priorities.reason: Best controlled receiving-side comparison for ordinary natural-history dealership.

priorities.target: Carrier/customs archives: Lloyd Triestino, NDL, NARA RG36
priorities.action: Search only against already known case marks, shipment dates, consignee/forwarder names and routes.
priorities.reason: High interpretive value but lower expected hit rate than direct correspondence/account sources.
